children: Our Bureau Mumbai: Central Bank of India's net profit rose 21% to 1,469 crore in the quarter ended September 2026 from 1,213 crore a year ago led by strong loan growth while asset quality remained stable. Net interest income (NII), or the difference between interest earned on loans and that paid for deposits, grew 26% year-on-year to 4,146 crore in September 2026 from 3,283 crore a year ago.

Other income including fees and treasury dropped 6% year-on-year to 1,380 crore in September 2026 from 1,469 crore a year ago. Total Income (interest income plus non-interest income) increased 15% from 10, 213 crore to 11,737 crore in September 2026. Cost to Income ratio reduced to 58.95% in September 2026 from 62.42% a year ago.

title: Central Bank of India's Q2 Profit Up 21%
